object.name: evi.squeeze~
object.description: <o>evi.squeeze~</o> is a simple passive audio signal quadratic shaper. <o>evi.squeeze~</o> is antialiased via anti derivative antialiasing, but is not designed for driving with high gain. Sadly this static waveshaper is expensive to compute.
object.discussion: See the helpfile for an example of how to cope with unknown input ranges.

inlets.description: Audio input is expected not to exceed -1..1

attributes.name: harmonics
attributes.description: The shaper can be switched between soft..hard over 4 settings. 0 = the least harmonics (least squeezed), 3 = the most harmonics (most squeezed).
